source_instruction: i am looking fresh scent body lotion for dry skin.
query: I spent ten minutes this morning chasing my tabby cat off the kitchen counter where he kept trying to bat at the jar of honey I left out for tea, then I realized I forgot to water the pothos on my windowsill that’s been looking a little droopy lately, and when I stepped out to grab the mail I saw my neighbor walking their fluffy golden retriever puppy that just moved in last week. I’ve been lingering in the body care section lately, I’ve heard the fresh scented options work really well for dry skin, and all the picks I’ve glanced at so far stay under $20.
